description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutableAdaptable class in the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package. It contains tests for object equality, immutability, null handling, and header retrieval behavior.

classes.name: ImmutableAdaptableTest
classes.description: A final class containing unit tests for ImmutableAdaptable, verifying correctness of equals, immutability, null handling, and header retrieval.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableAdaptable's equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of ImmutableAdaptable are immutable and that certain parameter types are also immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullTopicPath
methods.description: Verifies that creating an ImmutableAdaptable instance with null parameters throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersReturnsEmptyHeadersIfNoneWereSet
methods.description: Tests that getDittoHeaders returns an empty headers object when none were set in the ImmutableAdaptable instance.
